list: **Contributor** can do everything except grant access. Granting access needs Owner or User Access Administrator.
**Contributor** access dene ke siwa sab kar sakta hai. Access dene ke liye Owner ya User Access Administrator chahiye.
**Global Administrator** has no access to Azure resources by default. Elevate access first.
**Global Administrator** ko default mein Azure resources ka access nahi. Pehle elevate access karein.
**Reader** on a storage account can't read blobs. Data needs a **Storage Blob Data** role.
Storage account par **Reader** blobs nahi parh sakta. Data ke liye **Storage Blob Data** role chahiye.
`NotActions` isn't a deny. Another role can still grant the action.
`NotActions` deny nahi hai. Doosra role phir bhi woh action de sakta hai.
**Tags don't inherit. Locks do.** Use an Azure Policy (Modify) to inherit tags.
**Tags inherit nahi hote. Locks hote hain.** Tags inherit karane ke liye Azure Policy (Modify) use karein.
A **ReadOnly lock** also blocks POST actions: listing storage keys, starting a VM.
**ReadOnly lock** POST actions bhi rokta hai: storage keys list karna, VM start karna.
Locks apply to everyone, Owners too. They cover the control plane, not data.
Locks sab par lagte hain, Owner par bhi. Yeh control plane par hain, data par nahi.
**Policy beats RBAC**: a Deny policy stops an Owner too.
**Policy RBAC par bhari hai**: Deny policy Owner ko bhi rokti hai.
Deny policies don't delete existing resources. They are only marked non-compliant.
Deny policy mojooda resources delete nahi karti. Woh sirf non-compliant mark hote hain.
**Budgets never stop resources.** They only alert (an action group can run automation).
**Budget kabhi resources band nahi karta.** Sirf alert deta hai (action group automation chala sakta hai).
Moving a subscription to another tenant removes all role assignments.
Subscription ko doosre tenant mein le jane se tamam role assignments khatam ho jate hain.
Licensing a user fails? Check **Usage location** first.
User ko license nahi lag raha? Pehle **Usage location** dekhein.
An **ad-hoc SAS** can't be revoked on its own. Rotate the key, or use a stored access policy from the start.
**Ad-hoc SAS** akela revoke nahi hota. Key rotate karein, ya shuru se stored access policy use karein.
**GRS** secondary can't be read until failover. **RA-GRS** can.
**GRS** ka secondary failover tak nahi parha ja sakta. **RA-GRS** ka parha ja sakta hai.
After a customer-managed failover, the account becomes **LRS** in the new primary region.
Customer-managed failover ke baad account naye primary region mein **LRS** ban jata hai.
**Archive** is offline: rehydrate first (up to 15 hours, standard priority).
**Archive** offline hai: pehle rehydrate karein (standard priority mein 15 ghante tak).
Archive isn't supported on ZRS, GZRS or RA-GZRS accounts.
Archive ZRS, GZRS ya RA-GZRS accounts par supported nahi.
**Infrastructure encryption** can be turned on only when you create the account.
**Infrastructure encryption** sirf account banate waqt on ho sakti hai.
A selected-networks firewall needs the **service endpoint on the subnet** as well as the VNet rule.
Selected networks wale firewall ko VNet rule ke sath **subnet par service endpoint** bhi chahiye.
Storage firewall IP rules accept **public** IPs only.
Storage firewall ke IP rules sirf **public** IPs lete hain.
Azure Files identity access needs **both** share-level RBAC and NTFS permissions.
Azure Files identity access ko share-level RBAC **aur** NTFS permissions **dono** chahiye.
SMB can't connect from home? The ISP is blocking **TCP 445**.
Ghar se SMB connect nahi hota? ISP **TCP 445** block kar raha hai.
Soft delete for Azure Files protects whole shares, not single files.
Azure Files ka soft delete poore share ko bachata hai, ek file ko nahi.
**Complete mode** deletes resources that aren't in the template. **Incremental** is the default.
**Complete mode** template mein na hone wale resources delete karta hai. Default **Incremental** hai.
A VM can join an **availability set only at creation**. Otherwise recreate the VM.
VM **availability set mein sirf banate waqt** shamil hoti hai. Warna VM dobara banayen.
Shutting down inside the OS leaves the VM **Stopped** and still billed. **Deallocate** stops compute billing.
OS ke andar se band karne par VM **Stopped** hoti hai aur bill aata rehta hai. **Deallocate** compute ka bill rokta hai.
Data on the **temporary disk** is lost on deallocation or redeploy.
**Temporary disk** ka data deallocate ya redeploy par khatam ho jata hai.
Managed disks can grow but **never shrink**.
Managed disk bari ho sakti hai, **choti kabhi nahi**.
Moving a VM to another resource group or subscription **doesn't change its region**. Its resource ID does change.
VM ko doosre resource group ya subscription mein le jane se **region nahi badalta**. Resource ID badal jati hai.
**Azure Disk Encryption retires on 15 September 2028.** Choose encryption at host for new VMs.
**Azure Disk Encryption 15 September 2028 ko retire hoga.** Nayi VMs ke liye encryption at host chunein.
**Slots and autoscale need Standard or higher.** Backups and custom domain TLS start at Basic.
**Slots aur autoscale ke liye Standard ya us se upar.** Backups aur custom domain TLS Basic se shuru hote hain.
Settings marked **Deployment slot setting** stay with the slot during a swap.
**Deployment slot setting** wali settings swap mein apne slot ke sath rehti hain.
Free managed certificates don't support **wildcards**.
Free managed certificates **wildcard** support nahi karte.
Multi-container groups in ACI are **Linux only**.
ACI mein multi-container groups **sirf Linux** hain.
ACI CPU or memory change = **delete and redeploy** the group.
ACI ka CPU ya memory badalna = group **delete kar ke dobara deploy**.
Azure reserves **5 IPs** in every subnet. The first usable address ends in **.4**.
Azure har subnet mein **5 IPs** reserve karta hai. Pehla qabil-e-istemal address **.4** par khatam hota hai.
**Peering isn't transitive**, and address spaces can't overlap.
**Peering transitive nahi**, aur address spaces overlap nahi ho sakti.
Peering must be created on **both** sides. **Initiated** means one side is missing.
Peering **dono** taraf banani hoti hai. **Initiated** ka matlab ek taraf baqi hai.
NSG: the **lowest number wins**, and processing stops at the first match.
NSG: **sab se chota number jeetta hai**, aur pehle match par ruk jata hai.
With NSGs on subnet and NIC, **both must allow**. Inbound: subnet then NIC. Outbound: NIC then subnet.
Subnet aur NIC dono par NSG ho to **dono ka allow zaroori**. Inbound: subnet phir NIC. Outbound: NIC phir subnet.
Same prefix: **UDR > BGP > system**. Different prefixes: the longest one wins.
Same prefix: **UDR > BGP > system**. Alag prefixes: sab se lamba jeetta hai.
A route table does nothing until it's **associated with a subnet**.
Route table **subnet se associate** hone tak kuch nahi karta.
An NVA needs **IP forwarding on its NIC** and in its OS.
NVA ko **NIC par IP forwarding** aur OS mein bhi chahiye.
**Standard load balancer and public IP are closed by default.** Add an NSG rule.
**Standard load balancer aur public IP default mein band hain.** NSG rule lagayen.
A **CNAME isn't allowed at the zone apex**. Use an alias record.
**Zone apex par CNAME nahi chalta**. Alias record use karein.
A private endpoint without its **privatelink DNS zone** still resolves to the public IP.
**privatelink DNS zone** ke baghair private endpoint ka naam public IP par hi resolve hota hai.
New VNets have **private subnets by default**: no outbound internet without NAT gateway or similar.
Naye VNets mein **subnets default mein private** hain: NAT gateway waghera ke baghair internet nahi.
**Resource logs go nowhere** until you create a diagnostic setting.
**Resource logs kahin nahi jate** jab tak diagnostic setting na banayen.
Silence alerts during maintenance = **alert processing rule**, not disabling rules.
Maintenance mein alerts khamosh karna = **alert processing rule**, rules band karna nahi.
The vault for VM backup must be in the **same region as the VM**. For Site Recovery use the **target** region.
VM backup ka vault **VM wale region** mein ho. Site Recovery ke liye **target** region.
Vault redundancy can be changed only **before the first backup is configured**.
Vault redundancy sirf **pehla backup configure hone se pehle** badalti hai.
One lost file = **file recovery**, not a full VM restore.
Ek file gum hui = **file recovery**, poori VM restore nahi.
DR drill = **test failover** into an isolated VNet. Then clean it up.
DR drill = isolated VNet mein **test failover**. Phir cleanup.
**Blobs, managed disks and PostgreSQL → Backup vault.** VMs, SQL in VMs and Azure Files → Recovery Services vault.
**Blobs, managed disks aur PostgreSQL → Backup vault.** VMs, VM ka SQL aur Azure Files → Recovery Services vault.
Free disk space and Windows events need the **Azure Monitor Agent**. CPU doesn't.
Disk ki khaali jagah aur Windows events ko **Azure Monitor Agent** chahiye. CPU ko nahi.
